title: Purple Potato Rosti with Green Salad
subtitle: served with thick yoghurt
description: Crisp grated purple potato rosti topped with a fennel, mint and rocket salad and served with thick yoghurt, a perfect summer dinner.

steps.text: Grate the potatoes on the large holes of a grater into a wide bowl. Add salt, black pepper and 1 tbsp olive oil and mix.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a small frying pan (about 20 cm). Transfer the potato mixture to the pan and press it down firmly.

Fry over high heat for 3 minutes, then reduce to low and fry for 3 more minutes. Flip onto a plate (browned side up), add the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil to the pan, slide the rosti back in and fry the other side the same way (3 minutes on high and 3 minutes on low).
Meanwhile, thinly slice the fennel, pick the mint leaves from 5 stalks, and mix all the salad ingredients in a wide bowl.
Transfer the rosti to a serving plate, pile the salad on top and serve with thick yoghurt.
